title: Message actions on hover
evidence: Finding: on the baseline the oracle shows no message actions on hover. 1.2.3, 2026-11-23: hoverLabel on both newest messages (sweep oracle-hover-message-*, scripts/lib/hover-label.mjs) changes nothing visible, in two runs, so neither capture was kept; 1.0.3's Reply / Add reaction / More labels are not on 1.2.3. Each 1.2.3 message is still a group labelled 'Message actions for your message at <time>' / 'for Oracle message at <time>', with no message action in it (only a message's own files and pictures can be pressed). So nothing is built: there is nothing to copy. Kept for a later Grok that adds them: the sweep recipes (on main), and branch hover-replay (435ed3c, PR #312 closed unmerged), where Gate A replays a hoverLabel act on ours and measures unhovered when ours has no such group. Its scene note: oracle-hover-* ids take the turn-1040 scene (gate/scenes.ts), where your only message is cut off, so a message-hover state needs a scene of its own. Before: 0.79.3 (2026-11-13) showed nothing on hover; 1.0.3 (2026-11-14, parity/oracle/cancel.json) showed Reply to your message, More message actions, Add reaction and Reply to Oracle message.
